author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: The partner emailed you about the Morrison v. Pacific Airlines personal injury matter. Read the email for the full assignment, then handle everything requested. Save the completed work product as both a draft and a court filing in the matter system. Add a note to the matter file logging that the work product is complete and ready for partner review. The draft and filing must reference $198,750, nws forecast, karen cho from the case file. Email the full analysis to the partner — the email body must contain the complete work product including the specific medical expense figure, the emergency response delay time, and the injury diagnosis from the vault documents. Include m-2024-406 in the matter note. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
